answer.location_description: Small 3x3 square near the top-left corner of the image, rows 1-3, columns 1-3, well away from the central blob.
answer.mechanism: Many first-layer units carry large weights on the 3x3 top-left patch, far larger than their weights on the surrounding background. Units 1, 3, 7, 8, 13, 18, 20, 24, 27 and 28 have strong positive patch weights, and these same units have positive weights on an annulus of radius about 4-7 around the centre, so they behave as large-blob detectors. Units 11, 12, 16, 17, 19, 21, 25, 26, 29 and 31 have strong negative patch weights, and these units have a negative annulus and a positive background, so they behave as small-blob detectors. Layer 2 combines them consistently. u0, u1, u10, u13 and u14 take positive input from the patch-positive units (e.g. u0: +81 from unit1, +90 from unit28, +73 from unit8) and have positive output weights (63, 91, 50, 99, 72). u9 and u11 take positive input from the patch-negative units (e.g. u9: +99 from unit26, +82 from unit25) and have negative output weights (-83, -54). A bright patch therefore turns on large-blob pathways, suppresses small-blob pathways, and pushes the logit toward class 1.
answer.evidence: In the patch region, unit 1 has weights 77 56 82 / 32 33 81 / 59 54 78 and unit 28 has 89 73 67 / 86 67 49 / 53 71 82. Unit 24 reaches up to 93 and unit 7 up to 88. In the opposite direction, unit 11 has -73 to -91, unit 29 has -96, and unit 12 reaches -99. Outside the patch, these units' background weights are in the noise range of about ±30. No other off-centre location has this kind of coherent, concentrated structure. The sign of each unit's patch weight matches its role in blob-size detection, and that role carries through layer 2 to the output sign.
answer.main_feature: The model measures blob extent with ring- and annulus-shaped filters around the image centre. Positive weight on an outer ring (radius about 4-7) signals a large blob, and negative weight on that ring together with positive weight on the background signals a small blob.
